title: Vanishing from coordinate dependence
statement: Let $n\ge 0$, let $f$ be real-valued on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $J,T$ be coordinate sets. If $f$ depends only on coordinates in $J$ and $T$ is not contained in $J$, then the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $T$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the sign cube of dimension $n$
